3122-3518-4812-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Undercover Operative by paying {2}{U}{U}, causing it to enter s a copy (with a shield counter if the condition is met) of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

1933-2226-2499.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1933-2226-2499.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Aether Adept by paying its mana cost.
When Aether Adept enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2701-3110-6072-7182.easyPrerequisites: "Graveshifter" chosen with Council of the Absolute.
2701-3110-6072-7182.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Council of the Absolute
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2113-3249-6920--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-3249-6920--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Silk triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3257-5147-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Rakdos Carnarium.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4785-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1008-1619-3967-4605-5542.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1008-1619-3967-4605-5542.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Undermountain Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Undermountain Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Undermountain Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1008-1619-3967-4605-5542.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

670-1619-4142-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6144.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Goliath Paladin to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

1636-7108-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-7108-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Sokka and each creature you control that has prowess triggers.
Resolve all prowess triggers as applicable, giving those creatures +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
1636-7108-7542.notes: As the Allies have prowess, they will trigger each loop after they are created.

338-6458-7690--165.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
338-6458-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4499-5901-7494.easyPrerequisites: Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
4499-5901-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

1308-2034-5220-6961-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1308-2034-5220-6961-7396.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1558-1671-2557-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-1671-2557-3875-4231.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

586-2438-5258-5618-7183.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4053-5499-6965--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-5499-6965--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

1339-1636-6827--119.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-1636-6827--119.description:
Tap Spider-Gwen using any free method.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to rummage.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1339-1636-6827--119.notes: You will get near-infinite products from the method used to tap Spider-Gwen as well. The no summoning sickness requirement may also be ignored depending on the card used.

678-5670-6537.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-5670-6537.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Tarpan from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Tarpan by paying {G}.
Repeat.

1350-2397-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

116-4661-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Vesuvan Doppelganger on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Vesuvan Doppelganger do not have summoning sickness.
116-4661-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Vesuvan Doppelganger.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Vesuvan Doppelganger.
Activate Vesuvan Doppelganger by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

618-997-5887.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1170-1645-2397-5478-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2178-2773-4147-4294.manaNeeded: {5}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2178-2773-4147-4294.notablePrerequisites:
It is your precombat main phase.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-2773-4147-4294.description:
Cast Etali from your hand or from the command zone by paying {5}{R}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it and Warstorm Surge trigger.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing damage equal to Etali's power to Etali.
Etali dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Etali dies, Hua Tuo triggers, untapping Hua Tuo.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from step 2.
If you decide to cast any other creature spells using Etali's trigger, Terror of the Peaks will trigger for each of them, dealing damage equal to the creature's power to any target.

2713-4449-4949.notablePrerequisites: Hateflayer does not have summoning sickness.
2713-4449-4949.description:
Activate Hateflayer by tapping it, adding {R} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Hateflayer by paying {R} and untapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

338-1545-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Scurry Oak.
You have a way to gain life.
338-1545-4186.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak equal to the amount of life gained.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Trostani, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

141-1810.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-1810.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Cackling Counterpart
141-1810.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Cackling Counterpart, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Cackling Counterpart, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
